thesis: The site is the inventory sheet: every section is a numbered tag clipped to it, and scrolling advances the tag number so the visitor watches their household travel from old room to new.

signature.name: inventory-tag
signature.summary: A kraft-paper tag shape with string hole, three-digit condensed number, room code (LR → LR), and condition line; appears in hero (No. 001 swing-in), process story steps, service cards, review sign-offs, price rows, and footer (No. 112). Sticky header counts the current tag via data-sw-signature='inventory-tag'.

motion.intro: Paper tag swings in on string, number prints in mono, filmstrip slides from right; ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Dresser travels across page: pads wrap, rides ramp, lands in floor-plan room (pinned ≥640px, stacked cards below).
Junk-sort stream: items slide into donation/recycling/landfill columns on scroll.
motion.hover: Hairline grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms, one language site-wide.
